notes:
Two of these run today (Tuesday, Nov 10) on the organisers' own pages, and a third is for Inuit families. None of the pages showed a closure notice for today. I did not open a page that confirms today's session, so a quick call before heading out is worthwhile.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Drop-in Playgroup, Village Playgroup – Family Resource Centre, Children's Village of Ottawa-Carleton (333 Churchill Ave North)",
      "age_fit": "Ages 0-5yrs",
      "when": "Tuesdays, morning drop-in 9:15am-11:15am (weekly timetable on their page; I did not see a notice for today either way)",
      "price": "Free",
      "source_name": "Children's Village of Ottawa-Carleton"
    },
    {
      "name": "EarlyON Drop-In, Blackburn Hamlet Community Centre (190 Glen Park Drive)",
      "age_fit": "Infants, toddlers and preschoolers",
      "when": "Tuesday and Thursday mornings, 9 a.m., September 8 - December 10, 2026",
      "price": "Free",
      "source_name": "Global Child Care Services"
    },
    {
      "name": "EarlyON Drop-In Playgroup, Tungasuvvingat Inuit (282 Dupuis Street, Vanier)",
      "age_fit": "Weekly Drop In Play Group for Inuit children ages 0-6",
      "when": "Tuesdays and Wednesdays, 12:00 pm - 3:00 pm; no registration, first-come first-served",
      "source_name": "Tungasuvvingat Inuit"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Children's Village:** its page prints the Tuesday morning slot. That page was an older copy, so I'd call before going.
- **Global Child Care Services:** the Blackburn Hamlet listing is clear. The rest of their table was garbled, so I left out their other locations.
- **Tungasuvvingat Inuit:** this one is only for Inuit children and their families.

I didn't pick the Ottawa Public Library toddler programs because the dated listings I found run on other days, not Tuesdays.
